newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Parmalat to shut only one Venezuela plant.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat to shut only one Venezuela plant.

text.p: Italy's Parmalat Finanziaria SpA on Wednesday said it was closing only one of its milk-processing plants in Venezuela, denying press reports that it planned to shut down four to seven facilities.

Parmalat said it was closing the Santa Barbara plant in western Zulia state and merging its operations into those of a second plant in neighboring Merida state. It plans to modernize and expand a third plant in Zulia at Machiques.

"We are in a process of consolidating our production, which will provide new sources of work and better technology for milk processing," the company's general director, Rafael Miranda, said in a statement.
"It is totally false that we're closing down Machiques," he said.
The company, which brought a stake in the state-owned milk company Indulac in 1995 for $14.7 million, now controls some 60 percent of the Venezuelan milk market.
Earlier Wednesday, Venezuela's powerful Congressional Finance Commission said it would appoint a special panel to investigate Parmalat's plans.
